title: Suyash Sawant
text:
Welcome
I am a PhD Candidate in the Department of Wildlife Ecology and Conservation (WEC) and the School of Natural Resources and Environment (SNRE) at the University of Florida. I am working in the Sieving Lab, studying the information landscapes of mixed-species flocks.
This website hosts my:

Research
Publications
Datasets
